entries.subject: Voyager ISS photographic products
entries.finding: The inspected GEOMED raster and label for C2684646 list 10.52882 km/native pixel by nominal body-center sampling, but no recorded Cressida surface intersection or located pixel center. Center-resolution metadata alone does not qualify a surface. A separate non-null surface-intersection query returns 3 observations, with best listed sampling 162.59793 km/pixel.
entries.revisitWhen: A Cressida observation or controlled reconstruction demonstrates useful native surface detail, body-fixed geometry and independent registration beyond the cited sampling or coverage limits.

entries.subject: Karkoschka (2001) adopted Voyager/HST shape
entries.finding: Table IV of the HST study supplies the adopted prolate semiaxes 46 × 37 × 37 km. The repeated minor axis is a model assumption, not an independently measured third dimension. French et al. (2024), Table 3 reproduces the separate Voyager size paper’s projected-radius and axis-ratio uncertainties; they are not individual-axis errors. The selected analytic shape supplies no local relief or surface pixels.
